capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia infobox: 24-module pack 246.8 / 212.7 kWh (total / usable).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: GM TechLink: the 24-module pack provides "approximately 200 kWh of available energy". Wikipedia's infobox says 212.7 kWh usable / 246.8 total (6 % higher; not recorded as a value).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Same GM Ultium NCMA cells as the 24-module pack (Weekly Driver); closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: GM TechLink: ~400 V per layer, layers switched in series for "800-volt DC fast charging". Treated as the 800 V class (as the Silverado EV 24- and 20-module records).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: GM's battery-preconditioning guide (chevrolet.com returns 403, search excerpt only): automatic with Google built-in navigation plus a manual Fast Charge Prep in the app; applied lineup-wide to GM Ultium vehicles as for Silverado EV/Equinox EV records. UNVERIFIED on a page for this model. GM TechLink (2022 Hummer) says the apps can precondition the battery for charging; automatic navigation-based preconditioning from the GM guide assumed for the 2024-2025 trucks.

dc_max_kw.notes: GM TechLink: Level 3 up to 800 V/350 kW; The Charge Port: 24-module pack reaches 350 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: The Charge Port: home charging up to 19.2 kW (about 80 A); Wikipedia 19.2 kW.
